note.p: Ed Pope notes the following possibiliuties: Aaron Graham Esq 66 Gt Russell St Bloomsbury Boyle's 1792, subscr 1797 to 12 copies of Edm J Eyre's play, Justice at Hatton Garden 1800, lived Gunnersbury PCC 1819. Trustee of Drury Lane Theatre and friend of Richard Brinsley Sheridan DNB 1751-1816. See Nathaniel Conant DNB 1745-1822, Peter Heywood DNB 1772-1831 (where Aaron Graham's brother is said to have been Col Graham of Stirlingshire) and Valentine Joyce DNB 1769-1800. Aaron Graham was probably all the Graham entries above in 1806 to 1808 except for 4.10.1807 which may have been the same Graham as the two October 1811 entries linked to North.

For Graham of Drury Lane see Bodleian Abinger c42 f27-8, c18 f83 and c10 f22 and 25 Sandford Graham Hist of Parl 1788-1852 (son of James 1753-1825 above) friend of Byron MP from 1812 married 1819 Thomas Graham Hist of Parl1748-1843 baron Lynedoch 1814 Boyle's 1792 Mrs G 25 Orchard St / G Esq 43 Berkeley Sq / G Esq 5 Portman St / G 56 Lower Gower St / G and Riseing 35 Leicester Sq / Boyle's 1800 Mrs G 3 Upper Grosvenor St / Mrs G 3 Upper Brook St / Mrs G 29 Lambs Conduit St / Dr Melville and Mrs G 34 Southampton St Covent Gdn / 1793 subscr to Lucy Peacock Mrs G St Martin's La Clementina Graham DNB 1782-1877 hostess and author / Janet Graham DNB 1723-1805 poet 1810 James Graham merchant of Berwick "author of several papers in various literary works, on Wool, Manufactures, Commerce, Cherters andc" assisting John Clennell in The New Agricultural and Commercial Magazine (Aberdeen Journal 5.12.1810). A public monument praising him for "endeavouring to promote the civil and religious liberties of his country" (York Herald 5.6.1819) was erected at Berwick where he had been coroner, he died 21.6.1816 aged 69. Other Berwick Grahams / William Graham son of William Graham of Berwick articled attorney 1785 / James Graham grocer and flaxdresser Berwick 1769 to 1811 bankrupt 1786 / John Graham baker Berwick premises burnt 1793 bankrupt 1802 1811 nearest in British Book Trades Index is George Graham printer 41 Poland St 1824 1834 Sir James Robert George Graham DNB 1792-1861 became 2nd bart 1824
